# Goodhart is inevitable once you can't watch everything

Once the eval only samples a slice of behavior, optimizing the eval and
optimizing the goal quietly diverge. This isn't a bug, it's just math.

- [[agentic-systems/agent-memory#Working memory]] — `span` · pinned@`9f1a3c0`
